content.title: Accepted Arrival, Delayed Container Anomaly | Return to the Unaware Group
content.summary: Complete a polite newcomer arrival and an ordinary social welcome before revealing any anomaly. Escalate through at least three related but different physical clues across multiple containers, withhold the complete cause, then return to the same group while the audience alone retains the secret.

quick_start.input_format: adult newcomer with at least two ordinary containers + completed polite arrival + acceptance by at least two established adults + at least three varied related container clues after acceptance + hidden cause withheld and no attack + return to the unaware group
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult ocean-lab courier bows between three sealed specimen pods and is welcomed by two researchers. After acceptance, pulsing condensation appears beneath one lid, a violet filament presses under another seal and salt crystals grow around a third latch; the final group frame continues orientation without noticing the pods.
required_anchors: Complete one polite arrival action before displaying any abnormal container detail.
Show the newcomer accepted by at least two established residents in one stable shared space.
Withhold the complete hidden cause and avoid a direct attack or confrontation.
Return to the same group while the secret remains outside their attention.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Complete a polite newcomer arrival and an ordinary social welcome before revealing any anomaly. Escalate through at least three related but different physical clues across multiple containers, withhold the complete cause, then return to the same group while the audience alone retains the secret.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Stage an original newcomer with at least two ordinary-looking containers and complete one polite arrival action before showing any anomaly. Establish a stable social-acceptance frame with existing residents. Only then enter a delayed evidence phase: use at least three container close-ups, each revealing a different but related physical sign while withholding the complete hidden cause. Return to the same accepted group without letting them resolve the secret, so the audience retains one clear informational advantage. The reusable mechanism is normal arrival, social acceptance, delayed object anomaly and unaware-group return—not the source characters, faces, outfits, suitcases, fingers, chains, seals, room, horror motifs, camera, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Complete one polite arrival action before displaying any abnormal container detail.
invariants.purpose: Lets normality earn the later rupture.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate anomaly removes the delayed-recognition effect.

invariants.rule: Show the newcomer accepted by at least two established residents in one stable shared space.
invariants.purpose: Creates a social baseline and a consequence for the hidden evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without acceptance, the close-ups are merely object design.

invariants.rule: Reveal at least three different but related physical clues across two or more containers.
invariants.purpose: Builds a patterned secret without fully explaining it.
invariants.ablation_failure: One clue can read as decoration; identical clues do not escalate.

invariants.rule: Withhold the complete hidden cause and avoid a direct attack or confrontation.
invariants.ablation_failure: A full creature reveal resolves the question too early.

invariants.rule: Return to the same group while the secret remains outside their attention.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on an object close-up lacks the social consequence.

slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source anime women, faces, bodies, hair, outfits, poses and exact social grouping
the source safehouse corridor, room, moon view, shelves, shower and interior design
the source decorated suitcases, protruding hands, chains, seals, locks, symbols and horror details
the source camera positions, insert order, color palette, exact animation and 16-second rhythm
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.0 and Higgsfield claims, watermark, overlay and branding
